$comment: CompanyIntel indexer configuration — set from the REAL bucket contents.
Both sources are MODE B (`r2://bucket/key`): they are already in R2 and are
read in bounded ranged requests by tools/indexer/src/source.ts. The exact keys,
sizes and schemas below come from read-only runs of `bun run verify:r2` and
`bun run r2:schema` against the live bucket; nothing here is guessed.
Measured (2026-10-16, read-only):
raw/file1.csv  10,223,471,749 bytes  TSV (tab), UTF-8, 51 columns, 1 header row
-> ORGANIZATIONS: organization_id, organization_name,
organization_domain, organization_website_url, industries, HQ
location, employees, revenue, phone
raw/file2.csv  54,038,527,871 bytes  TSV (tab), UTF-8, 39 columns, 1 header row
-> PEOPLE: person_name, title, seniority, email, phone, LinkedIn,
location, sanitized_organization_name_unanalyzed +
current_organization_ids (the company link)
Every `columns` entry below overrides an automatic suggestion that was WRONG or
ambiguous. The two that matter most:
- csv1.companywebsite: the profiler could not choose between
organization_website_url and organization_domain (both look like URLs), and
a website and a domain are different canonical fields.
- csv1: organization_phone is deliberately NOT mapped to the canonical `phone`,
which is a CONTACT field. Mapping a switchboard number onto a person would
invent contact data.
R2 credentials are never stored here: they are resolved automatically from the
private, git-ignored .r2-credentials.json (or R2_* environment variables) by
tools/indexer/src/credentials.ts. See docs/configuration.md.
Before a real run: `bun run index:profile` to confirm the mapping, then a
`--sample` pass, then ask for approval before the full 60 GB job.
$commentRawCacheDir: MODE B only: each R2 object is streamed to this directory once (via a .part
file that is renamed only after the byte count matches R2), so a re-run resumes
from disk instead of downloading 60 GB again. Budget ~1.0x the input size here
in addition to workDir, or set it to null to stream without caching.
A bounded `--sample` run never completes a cache file: it stops early and the
$commentObjectSizes: Companies per object and contacts per object are fixed in code (SHARDING in
src/shared/search/index-format.ts) because the Worker derives the object key for
a document reference from those same constants. Changing them requires a new
index format version and a rebuild.
